newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to pay part of Hungary debt in kind - agency.
newsitem.headline: Russia to pay part of Hungary debt in kind - agency.

text.p: Russia will pay part of its debts to Hungary in machinery and coal, Itar-Tass news agency quoted a Hungarian diplomat in Russia as saying on Friday.
The agency quoted trade representative Pal Szucs as saying the two countries had signed contracts for the delivery of $600 million of Russian goods as payment for part of Russia's $900 million debt.
Military equipment, including anti-tank complexes for ground troops and spare parts for MiG-29 fighters, will account for $320 million of the shipment, Itar-Tass said.
Russia will deliver $60 million worth of coal and $27 million worth of Zhiguli and Moskvich cars, Szucs said.
The rest will be paid in trucks, ships, railway carriages and reservoirs for oil products, he said.
